name: REVbot: Ghidra Reverse Engineering
summary: Reverse-engineers binaries you're allowed to analyze with Ghidra via GhidraMCP: decompiles and annotates functions, maps imports, strings and cross-references.
summary_zh: 通过 GhidraMCP 用 Ghidra 逆向你有权分析的二进制：反编译并注释函数，梳理导入表、字符串和交叉引用。适用于自有构建、旧固件和防御性恶意软件分析。
